title: What to Ask a Caterer About Halal Ingredients
body_markdown:
Start halal menu planning by stating the ingredients and sourcing requirements your guests expect. Ask for relevant supplier information and confirm how the menu will be prepared and served.

For the service options, explore [catering services in Dubai](/catering-dubai). Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

## About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

## Define the requirements clearly

State the ingredients to exclude, the preparation expectations and any supplier certificates you need to review. Ask about meat, poultry, stocks, sauces, gelatin and other purchased components. A general menu description should lead to a clear written agreement.

## Check the proposed kitchen and service

Confirm who prepares the food and how the agreed requirements are managed during preparation, transport and service. If other menus are handled in the same kitchen, discuss the separation arrangements relevant to your brief.

## Treat allergies as a separate assessment

Halal sourcing does not establish that a dish is suitable for a particular allergy. Share the full dietary list so the provider can assess ingredient information and cross-contact limitations. Compare the menu, service, documentation and total price together.

## Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

## Use your completed brief

If halal catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.

[Explore halal catering](/halal-catering-dubai) · [Request a proposal](/inquiry)
